title: A normalized completed scalar associator localizes canonically
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, finite extensions $E,L,M/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], embeddings $i:E\to L$, $j:L\to M$, and a scheme $T$. Let $\mathcal C_A(T)$ be the integral finite-Tor category, $I_A$ its full inclusion into the completed-coefficient derived category, and $R_A$ its raw rationalization [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Put $S_i,S_j,S_{ji}$ for the completed integral scalar extensions [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], $O_i,O_j,O_{ji}$ for the ordinary derived scalar extensions along the completed coefficient maps, and $\chi_i:O_i\to S_i$, $\chi_j$, $\chi_{ji}$ for the prescribed quotient-completion comparisons [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $A:\mathcal C_E(T)\to\mathcal C_L(T)$, $B:\mathcal C_L(T)\to\mathcal C_M(T)$ and $D:\mathcal C_E(T)\to\mathcal C_M(T)$ be scalar functors in the sense of the cited construction, with realizations $\sigma_A:I_L A\cong O_i I_E$, and similarly for $B,D$. Assume the functor equalities $I_L A=S_i I_E$, $I_M B=S_j I_L$, $I_M D=S_{ji} I_E$, and assume that the components of $\sigma_A^{-1},\sigma_B^{-1},\sigma_D^{-1}$ equal the components of $\chi_i,\chi_j,\chi_{ji}$ through these object identifications. Let $\alpha:BA\cong D$ satisfy the defining ScalarComposition normalization: $I_M(\alpha_K)$ followed by $\sigma_{D,K}$ equals $\sigma_{B,AK}$ followed by $O_j(\sigma_{A,K})$ and the ordinary balanced tensor associator at $I_EK$. Then for every $K\in\mathcal C_E(T)$, the component of the specified rational scalar associator $a^{\mathrm{rat}}_{j,i}$ [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition] at $R_EK$ equals $R_M(\alpha_K)$ through the specified scalar object equalities. This is an equality transported forward by localization; it makes no faithfulness assertion about raw localization and has no compact-support operation or coefficient comparison $q$ among its inputs.

proof.text: Use the full inclusion and the three functor equalities to identify the scalar functors with the restrictions of completed scalar extension. The inverse-realization normalizations identify their realization maps with quotient completion. Compare the two ordinary scalar implementations on K-flat resolutions: their tensor sections induce the canonical transport, and both completion maps have the prescribed quotient coordinates and zero shifted Roos coordinate. Uniqueness of descent identifies this transported comparison with sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison.

proof.text: Cancel the direct completion comparison in the normalized associator equation. On double pure tensors the supplied ordinary tensor associator and CompletedLineTensor.associatorData both multiply the two coefficient factors in the same order. The unique counit-normalized ordinary-model transport identifies them. The equation is therefore the completed chi-conjugation formula. Apply the existing CompletedLineTensor.canonical_restriction to identify that conjugate with sfIntegralScalarComp. Faithfulness identifies the restricted integral components. Apply raw localization and the component specification of sfRationalScalarComp. This transports equality forward only and includes identity embeddings and repeated fields.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_scalar_associator_localization
    (E L M : FieldStage.{max u v} l)
    (i : E.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] L.carrier) (j : L.carrier →ₐ[Padic l] M.carrier)
    (T : Scheme.{max u v})
    (A : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral E) (t := .integral L)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier L.carrier i) T)
    (B : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral L) (t := .integral M)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l L.carrier M.carrier j) T)
    (D : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω (s := .integral E) (t := .integral M)
      (PurCompactSupport.completedChange l E.carrier M.carrier (j.comp i)) T)
    (hA : A.functor ⋙ (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l L.carrier T).ι =
      (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier T).ι ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier L.carrier i T)
    (hB : B.functor ⋙ (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l M.carrier T).ι =
      (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l L.carrier T).ι ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l L.carrier M.carrier j T)
    (hD : D.functor ⋙ (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l M.carrier T).ι =
      (finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier T).ι ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier M.carrier (j.comp i) T)
    (nA : ∀ K, HEq (A.realization.inv.app K)
      ((completedScalarComparison l E.carrier L.carrier i T).app K.obj))
    (nB : ∀ K, HEq (B.realization.inv.app K)
      ((completedScalarComparison l L.carrier M.carrier j T).app K.obj))
    (nD : ∀ K, HEq (D.realization.inv.app K)
      ((completedScalarComparison l E.carrier M.carrier (j.comp i) T).app K.obj))
    (α : ScalarComposition.{u, v} l Ω
      (PurCompactSupport.completedMap_composition l E.carrier L.carrier i M.carrier j)
      T A B D)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E)) :
    HEq ((sfRationalScalarComp l E.carrier L.carrier i T 0
      (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero M.carrier j).hom.app
        ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E T).obj K))
      ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω M T).map (α.iso.hom.app K))
